people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Jephthah
people.line: A judge of Israel, known for his tragic vow.

translations.web: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Yahweh will be witness between us. Surely we will do what you say.”
translations.bsb: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “The LORD is our witness if we do not do as you say.”
translations.kjv: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.
translations.asv: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Jehovah shall be witness between us; surely according to thy word so will we do.
